full_name: Francesca Orsini | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Humanities Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow University of London (United Kingdom)
bio: Francesca Orsini is a reader in the literatures of north India at SOAS, University of London, and works with Hindi, Urdu, and Indo-Persian texts. She is interested in the ways in which a multilingual approach to literary history can challenge identitarian approaches to literary history in India and also provide an appropriate model for understanding the dynamics of world literature from the bottom up.
